package.description: CLI for PDQ Connect and PDQ Detect

en-US.description: CLI for PDQ Connect and PDQ Detect
en-US.longDescription:
A command-line interface for PDQ products. Query and manage devices, groups, packages, and deployments via the PDQ Connect API. Query devices, vulnerabilities, applications, and scan surfaces via the PDQ Detect API.
This is an unofficial tool, not affiliated with or endorsed by PDQ.com.
en-US.name: pdq-cli
